expectations_used.clarify: Reads the failing test body and asks whether partially shipped holds should return only unshipped units before editing.
expectations_used.approach: Names the mechanism — the sweep releasing the original count rather than the remaining count — not merely "something in the sweep".
expectations_used.communicate: Narrates what the failure diff shows and which hold-state fields are being traced.
expectations_used.implement: Changes the sweep's released-quantity computation to test the stated hypothesis.
expectations_used.verify: Re-runs the suite and confirms the partially-shipped expiry test passes without breaking full-release behavior.
expectations_used.reflect: Explains why releasing the original count created phantom stock and how the remaining-count fix prevents it.

summary: The candidate relied heavily on interviewer nudges to locate the failing test's meaning and the sweep's mechanism, but once pointed there, correctly identified the original-vs-remaining count bug, made a scoped fix, and verified with a passing test run. The session ended abruptly right after the green run with no closing reflection on why the fix works.

dimensions.analysis: The candidate did read the failing test output and articulate what the diff showed, but this was in direct response to an interviewer nudge rather than self-initiated clarification, and no genuine ambiguity requiring a question was surfaced or resolved by the candidate independently.

After the second nudge pointed them at the sweep's released quantity, the candidate correctly named the mechanism -- releasing original count instead of remaining count -- before editing. This is the right mechanism-level hypothesis, but it was prompted rather than self-derived from independent investigation.

The candidate narrated their read of the failing test diff and their hypothesis about the sweep mechanism at two key points, giving enough of a trail to follow, though the narration was sparse and mostly reactive to nudges rather than a continuous explanation of their reasoning.

The edit to src/sweep.ts was scoped tightly to the stated hypothesis (original vs remaining count) and was made promptly after stating the mechanism, with no scattered or contradictory changes observed.

The candidate re-ran the full test suite after the fix and confirmed a pass before ending the session, meeting the basic bar for verification, though there was no explicit check of edge cases like full-release holds beyond the suite passing.

The candidate ended the session immediately after the tests passed with no articulation of why the remaining-count fix resolves the phantom stock issue or any summary of the root cause connecting back to partially-shipped holds; the reflection step was skipped entirely.
